description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimAttachmentAPI class which implements API endpoints for managing claim attachments in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting claim attachments, with validation rules, transaction management, and integration with the claim service and data models.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentAPI
classes.description: A class that provides REST API endpoints for managing claim attachments, including listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting attachments. It extends the Endpoint class and implements the CrudEndpoint interface, utilizing traits for common functionalities and integrating with the claim system's data models.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim attachments filtered by request ID, with sorting and pagination options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new claim attachment for a specified claim request, with transaction management and validation.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets the attachment data (file, description, metadata) on the ClaimAttachment object from the request payload.

methods.name: getPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Returns a partial view of the claim attachment suitable for API response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple claim attachments associated with a specified request ID, with validation and transaction handling.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific claim attachment by request ID and attachment ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim attachment with new data or a new file, handling validation and transactions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing claim attachments, including request ID and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new claim attachment, including required fields and file validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting attachments, specifically request ID and list of IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific attachment, requiring request ID and attachment ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an attachment, including optional file and description fields.
